commit.message:
Reuse macOS code for clamping SO_LINGER on BSD

This work is sponsored by The FreeBSD Foundation

Reduce max SO_LINGER value for BSD

The BSD's store the SO_LINGER value in a signed short internally, so we
need to clamp the value to 32767. This is based on an original patch by
Greg Lewis, but without changing the existing limit for other platforms.

This work is sponsored by The FreeBSD Foundation

Fix SetSoLinger.java test case

Max value for SO_LINGER is 32767 on BSD as well as on MacOs. This was
originally fixed by setting the max expected linger value to 32767 for
all platforms in commit f5d5ddb by Greg Lewis. This patch only modifies
the expected max value for BSD.

This work is sponsored by The FreeBSD Foundation
